about_the_game:
With the Tyrant’s seal weakening, Tenrin Dominion moves one step closer to their ultimate goal: The Undawning. A phenomenon that can only be described as the eternal day, the death of night.

The world needs a hero more than anything now, and I know you’re just as excited as me.

What begins as a small, hopeful adventure soon spirals into the heart of politics, war, and sacrifice. In Undawning: The New Moon, you will guide Cassius, a young man chasing the ideals of the heroes he once admired, through a fractured land caught between light and shadow. His journey is not only to face monsters, but to confront his own doubts, failures, and the meaning of heroism itself.

Features:

  • A hauntingly beautiful atmosphere draped over a dark, uncertain world

  • Turn-based tactical combat that rewards careful positioning and planning

  • Multiple class paths, unique skillsets, and deep synergy potential

  • Companions with their own goals, stories, and… own wits

  • At least one cat

  • A character-driven story about growth, failure, and the quiet strength in trying anyway.

short_description: Everyone, at least once, dreams of becoming a hero. But what does it truly mean to be one? Help Cassius confront his doubts and ideals in his journey to become the kind of hero he once admired in this grid-based Pixel RPG.
